_comment: Market-bot config. enabled:false = the autonomous loop (start-market-bot.sh / admin_market.py scan-loop) is a no-op; flip to true to arm it. Each tick the bot tops its NPC listings up toward max_listings (priced by the Coastal sane-pricing model: vendor_price x vendor_multiplier or a tier/stack fallback x grade_multiplier, step-rounded, capped at price_cap) and runs a gamble-buy pass: it buys cheap PLAYER sell orders (per-item price <= our price x buy_threshold) gated by a d-die roll (buy iff roll in 1..gamble_target on a gamble_die-sided die), up to max_buys_per_tick per tick, paying the seller and destroying the item (pure demand sink). Set gamble_target:0 or buy_threshold:0 to disable buying while still posting. scan_interval_secs is the loop cadence (min 30).
